open_points.subject: A17 listener-address and network-reachability ownership
open_points.text:
The addresses are the deployment's: the
service API is reachable only in VM Platform and over the WireGuard
channel from the VPS, the owner interface only through the owner's VPN
(R0-28, R0-29, R0-48), and the interface each is bound to on that host,
or on a test instance's (R0-34), is the host's administration — so the
configuration names them
open_points.question: Is the choice of listener interface and the reachability/HTTPS rule owned outside the running instance by the host's administration, or is it part of A17 owned by `configuration` under the stated rule that A17's primary owner owns every rule not assigned elsewhere?
options: Declare this part of A17 explicitly outside all runtime modules and owned by host administration
Make `configuration` own and enforce that each address is on an allowed deployment interface
Split ownership: host administration owns reachability and HTTPS, while `configuration` owns only address syntax and cross-address checks
open_points.default_guess: Split ownership: host administration owns reachability and HTTPS, while `configuration` owns only address syntax and cross-address checks
